name: s151-prompt-router-broken-python3-still-routes
setup_commands: chmod +x bin/python3 minbin/python3 && for t in bash sh awk cat dirname grep head sed tr; do p=$(command -v "$t") && ln -sf "$p" "minbin/$t"; done; true
notes: python3 on PATH is the macOS xcode-select stub, which exits 1. Parsing only checked that python3 existed, so the prompt read as empty and the router stayed silent. The usable-python3 probe (lib/python3.sh) now counts the stub as absent: jq reads the prompt (step 1, where jq is installed), and without jq the bash extraction does (step 2). The no-parser step includes escaped JSON quotes so the bash decoder is exercised.
